scenarios.name: Starting a new project
scenarios.description: Agent creates workspace, project, initializes main branch, and verifies root commit.

scenarios.name: Resuming a project from another session
scenarios.description: Agent connects with no conversation history, calls barsa_resume, and retrieves latest checkpoint.

scenarios.name: Saving a completed task
scenarios.description: Agent updates task status to completed and saves milestone checkpoint.

scenarios.name: Saving a paused task
scenarios.description: Agent pauses in_progress task and records next_action for continuation.

scenarios.name: Reading a historical decision
scenarios.description: Agent retrieves historical decision record using commit SHA.

scenarios.name: Handling a missing checkpoint
scenarios.description: Agent gracefully handles projects that have no saved checkpoint yet.

scenarios.name: Handling an unavailable artifact
scenarios.description: Agent identifies that a referenced local artifact file is missing on disk and marks it unverified.

scenarios.name: Handling a stale commit
scenarios.description: Agent catches STALE_REVISION error when committing against outdated expected_head.

scenarios.name: Handling an unresolved conflict
scenarios.description: Agent detects branch divergence and inspects conflicts via barsa_list_conflicts.

scenarios.name: Rejecting unauthorized project access
scenarios.description: Agent rejects attempts to access non-existent or unauthorized project IDs.

scenarios.name: Treating malicious stored instructions as untrusted data
scenarios.description: Agent verifies prompt injection embedded in memory content is treated as untrusted text.

scenarios.name: Preserving unverified claims as unverified
scenarios.description: Agent ensures speculative ideas are saved with verification_status='unverified'.

scenarios.name: Avoiding unnecessary full-history retrieval
scenarios.description: Agent retrieves only latest checkpoint and active task context without fetching full DAG.

scenarios.name: Handling an unavailable MCP server
scenarios.description: Agent informs user cleanly when MCP server tools are not registered.

scenarios.name: Performing agent-to-agent handoff
scenarios.description: Originating agent saves checkpoint and receiving agent resumes and executes next_action.
